<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="Y9I0TYlJnBepd41VNZ-e"> <mxGraphModel dx="2110" dy="1600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%% Generic idempotency replay/conflict flow.
%% Applies to any idempotency-keyed mutating endpoint in this platform:
%% - auth-service: POST /authorisations, POST /authorisations/{id}/captures,
%% POST /authorisations/{id}/reversals
%% - fraud-service: POST /fraud/check
%% Scope key = (scopeId, idempotencyKey), e.g. (accountId, idempotencyKey) for authorise/fraud-check,
%% or (authorisationId, idempotencyKey) for capture/reverse.
%% Fingerprint = hash of the semantic request payload (see RequestHashing in shared-spring-lib),
%% used to distinguish a safe replay from a conflicting reuse of the same key.
sequenceDiagram
	autonumber
	actor Client
	participant Svc as Service
	participant Cache as Idempotency<br/>Cache (Redis)
	participant DB as Datastore<br/>(unique constraint on<br/>scopeId + idempotencyKey)

	rect rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
		note over Client, DB: 1) First request for this (scopeId, idempotencyKey)
		Client->>Svc: Request A (scopeId,<br/>idempotencyKey=K, payload=P1)
		Svc->>Cache: get(scopeId, K)
		Cache-->>Svc: miss
		Svc->>DB: conditional insert (scopeId,<br/>K, fingerprint(P1))
		DB-->>Svc: inserted (0 prior rows)
		Svc->>Svc: execute business operation
		Svc->>DB: persist result / domain event
		Svc->>Cache: store response (TTL)
		Svc-->>Client: 200 OK (result R1)
	end

	rect rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
		note over Client, DB: 2) Retry: same key + same payload -> safe replay
		Client->>Svc: Request B (scopeId,<br/>idempotencyKey=K, payload=P1)
		Svc->>Cache: get(scopeId, K)
		alt Cache hit
			Cache-->>Svc: cached response R1
			Svc-->>Client: 200 OK (replayed R1,<br/>no new side effect)
		else Cache miss (e.g. TTL expired)<br/>- fall back to durable store
			Svc->>DB: find existing row by (scopeId, K)
			DB-->>Svc: existing row, fingerprint(P1) matches
			Svc->>Svc: rebuild response from persisted state
			Svc-->>Client: 200 OK (replayed R1,<br/>no new side effect)
		end
	end

	rect rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
		note over Client, DB: 3) Retry: same key + different payload -> conflict
		Client->>Svc: Request C (scopeId,<br/>idempotencyKey=K, payload=P2 != P1)
		Svc->>Cache: get(scopeId, K)
		Cache-->>Svc: cached response R1<br/>(fingerprint stored = fingerprint(P1))
		Svc->>Svc: compare fingerprint(P2) vs<br/>stored fingerprint(P1) -> mismatch
		Svc-->>Client: 409 Conflict (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT)
	end

	rect rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)
		note over Client, DB: 4) Concurrent race: two first-time requests,<br/>same key, at the same time
		par Request D (payload=P1)
			Client->>Svc: Request D (scopeId, K, P1)
			Svc->>DB: conditional insert (scopeId,<br/>K, fingerprint(P1))
		and Request E (payload=P1, concurrent)
			Client->>Svc: Request E (scopeId, K, P1)
			Svc->>DB: conditional insert (scopeId,<br/>K, fingerprint(P1))
		end
		DB-->>Svc: one insert wins, the other<br/>violates the unique constraint
		note over Svc: Loser does not fail the request - it re-reads the winner's<br/>committed row instead of retrying the write
		Svc->>DB: find committed row by (scopeId, K)
		DB-->>Svc: winner's row, fingerprint(P1)<br/>matches loser's payload
		Svc-->>Client: 200 OK (both callers observe<br/>the same result R1)
	end


",
 "config": null
}" id="BoGchFhTnOTgTzf14KKM-1"> <mxCell connectable="0" parent="1" style="group;transparentBounds=1;editIcon=1;lockedGroup=0;groupPadding=10;labelBackgroundColor=none;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry
